forecastSection.title: Deterministic 30-Day Cash Trajectory
forecastSection.description: Forward simulation built using verified historical velocity, 90% conservative accounts receivable collection factor, and 100% accounts payable commitments.
forecastSection.assumptionAr: Accounts Receivable: 90% collection factor applied to pending invoices within projected window.
forecastSection.assumptionAp: Accounts Payable: 100% fulfillment on scheduled supplier obligations.
forecastSection.assumptionRunRate: Baseline Velocity: Daily run-rate derived from verified historical cash burn and inflow movements.
forecastSection.disclaimer: This projection is an automated mathematical model for analytical planning and does not constitute a guaranteed banking balance.

sufficiency.title: Data Sufficiency Audit
sufficiency.insufficientDesc: Fewer than 30 days of transactions are recorded. Forecast reliability improves significantly with at least 60 to 90 days of consistent operating data.
